question: Why does Bhairava praise the great goddess for asking about a matter rare even for gods?
premises: He states that he has been asked.
The matter asked about is hard to obtain even for the gods.
inference: Bhairava praises the goddess because her question concerns a matter rare even among the gods.
plain_english: Well said, well said, O great goddess; I have been asked about something hard to obtain even for the gods.
